description: Specific units and companies that have appeared in the history of The Lord of the Rings. A lore layer, not standalone armies — some return, others are themed for a specific year.
title: Specific units
subtitle: Companies that have appeared in the history of The Lord of the Rings — from Glóin’s corps to the crew of the Deep.
intro_pre: Over the years several themed units have appeared at our LARP. Some came from organisers’ stories, others were brought by players and we wove them into the game.

h_own: Want to bring your own company?
own_p1: If you have an idea for a themed company — a merchant caravan, a mercenary squad, a clan, or a small themed unit in the style of one of the main armies — contact the organisers. Some of the units above arose exactly that way, brought by players themselves.
